wave: ABSORPTION -- BLAKE3 unkeyed hash mode absorbed natively as core::identity::blake3 and wired into inventory as ArtifactRecord.content_digest (ADR 0005). Third real absorption (souffle, datafrog before it); first prerequisite of R5 incremental recensus and of salsa's narrowed blocking question.

selection.capability_gap: R5 'incremental recensus of changed source': ArtifactRecord carried no content identity; IntegrityDigest type existed but was never constructed; FNV stable_id is a label and must never be a change detector
selection.why_this_donor: frontier-classification lane ranked rust-analyzer vfs change stream CANDIDATE_ABSORB_NOW, but its state transitions (Created/Modified/Deleted) presuppose a per-file content identity that did not exist; the digest is the strict prerequisite, and blake3 is the admitted donor for wire digest id 1
selection.superseded_rejection: .atlas/genome/technology/blake3-content-addressing.md Rejected alternatives -- superseded for the unkeyed mode only; original text retained with a Decision update

conditions.condition: hash mode only; no keyed/derive machinery; secret-input use stays EXTERNAL_BOUNDARY
conditions.implemented_by: core::identity::blake3 contains no KEYED_HASH/DERIVE_KEY flags, key words or constructors; test production_source_carries_no_keyed_or_derive_key_machinery

conditions.condition: vetted crate as dev-dependency-only differential oracle, never [dependencies]
conditions.implemented_by: core/Cargo.toml [dev-dependencies] blake3 = "=1.8.7"; tests differential_against_the_vetted_blake3_crate (42 cases: boundary lengths, 24 random lengths up to 1 MiB, 4 patterns, random update splits, 32-byte hash + 200-byte XOF) and a_chunk_beyond_two_to_the_32_matches_the_vetted_crate (hazmat set_input_offset)

conditions.condition: single-handle, fstat-verified, length-bounded reads with a size cap; None digest means changed
conditions.implemented_by: adapter::source::read_file_content: lstat pre-check in classify_file, fstat is_file + same dev/inode post-open, take(len+1), MAX_DIGEST_BYTES = 256 MiB; over-cap / replaced / length-mismatch => content_digest None + content_digest_withheld reason

conditions.condition: parsed bytes must equal digested bytes before any cache reuse; cache key must include extractor identity
conditions.implemented_by: DEFERRED to the first cache consumer -- recorded on salsa's blocking_question and in ADR 0005 Consequences; no cache exists yet

conditions.condition: typed, validated digest mapping one-to-one onto wire id 1
conditions.implemented_by: IntegrityDigest private field; parse/TryFrom<String> (serde try_from) accept only blake3-256: + 64 lowercase hex; wire_algorithm_id() == 1

conditions.condition: supersession record keeping the original reasoning

security_lane.residual: a FIFO swapped in between the walker's lstat and open would block the open (std offers no portable O_NONBLOCK/O_NOFOLLOW without a libc dependency); this requires a concurrent local writer inside the censused tree, pre-exists this change (the old binary sniff opened the same way), and the fstat inode check guarantees no wrong digest is ever emitted

results.take_exact (take(len) instead of take(le: KILLED by the procfs length test
results.sniff_everything: SURVIVED first run (fixture NUL at byte 150,000 fell outside the first 64 KiB buffer); fixture moved to byte 20,000 (inside the first buffer, past the 8 KiB sample); then KILLED

falsification.restoration: every mutant restored by the scratch driver; git diff after the battery showed only the intended change set

blocker_fixed_in_scope.finding: adding the two digest fields to ArtifactRecord made the existing 600-level deeply_nested_directory_tree_does_not_abort_the_process test overflow the 2 MiB test-thread stack: classify_entry held ArtifactRecord temporaries in the frame that recursed into visit_inventory, so per-level stack cost scaled with the record type
blocker_fixed_in_scope.fix: classify_entry no longer recurses; record_entry classifies/records in its own non-recursive frame and hands back the subdirectory; visit_inventory's recursive frame holds only an Option<PathBuf>
blocker_fixed_in_scope.verified: the deep-nesting test passes again; all 18 source tests pass

production_path.result: inventory schema atlas.inventory-report.v2; 69 FILE artifacts, 69 digested, 0 withheld; e.g. adapter/Cargo.toml blake3-256:9cf3dee4...; coding_admission.blockers []

throughput: release, 64 MiB input: native ~450 MiB/s vs upstream SIMD crate ~4 GiB/s single-threaded; outputs asserted equal in the benchmark
overall_verdict: ABSORBED (mechanism level: unkeyed hash mode). Remaining donor surface dispositioned: keyed/derive EXTERNAL_BOUNDARY; SIMD/platform/rayon/hazmat/C/b3sum REFERENCE_ONLY. Extinction evaluated as a separate unit.
